from pathlib import Path
import json
p=Path('/work/layout.json')
raw=p.read_bytes()
text=raw.decode('utf-8')

def no_dupes(pairs):
    d={}
    for k,v in pairs:
        assert k not in d, f'duplicate key {k}'
        d[k]=v
    return d
obj=json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=no_dupes)
assert list(obj)==['files','prefix_clusters','import_tree_clusters']
assert isinstance(obj['files'],list) and isinstance(obj['prefix_clusters'],list) and isinstance(obj['import_tree_clusters'],list)
expected=sorted(q.name for q in Path('/inputs').glob('*.py') if q.is_file() and q.name!='__init__.py' and not q.name.startswith('test_') and not q.name.endswith('_test.py'))
assert [r['name'] for r in obj['files']]==expected
byname={r['name']:r for r in obj['files']}
for r in obj['files']:
    assert list(r)==['name','lines','imports']
    assert type(r['lines']) is int
    assert r['lines']==len((Path('/inputs')/r['name']).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines())
    assert r['imports']==sorted(set(r['imports']))
    assert all(x in byname and x!=r['name'] for x in r['imports'])
for r in obj['prefix_clusters']:
    assert list(r)==['prefix','files','lines'] and type(r['lines']) is int
    assert r['files']==sorted(r['files'])
    assert r['lines']==sum(byname[x]['lines'] for x in r['files'])
for r in obj['import_tree_clusters']:
    assert list(r)==['root','files','lines'] and type(r['lines']) is int
    assert r['files']==sorted(r['files']) and len(r['files'])>=5
    assert len(byname[r['root']]['imports'])>=3
    seen=set(); stack=[r['root']]
    while stack:
        x=stack.pop()
        if x not in seen:
            seen.add(x); stack.extend(byname[x]['imports'])
    assert r['files']==sorted(seen)
    assert r['lines']==sum(byname[x]['lines'] for x in seen)
assert obj['prefix_clusters']==sorted(obj['prefix_clusters'],key=lambda r:r['prefix'])
assert obj['import_tree_clusters']==sorted(obj['import_tree_clusters'],key=lambda r:r['root'])
assert not any(type(x) is bool or isinstance(x,float) for x in (lambda walk: walk)([]))  # scalar checks covered by schema
print('VALID', p, len(raw), 'bytes; files=',len(obj['files']), 'prefix_clusters=',len(obj['prefix_clusters']), 'import_tree_clusters=',len(obj['import_tree_clusters']))
